title: v1.110.0-rc.1
excerpt: Verify Docker Image Signature All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with cosign . This release is signed with the key introduced in commit e82a3c6 . Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended): A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1 Verify using the release tag (convenience): Tags are protected in this repository and resolve to the same key. This option is easier to read but relies on tag protection rules: cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/v1.110.0-rc.1/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.1 Expected output: The following checks were performed on each of these signatures: - The cosign claims were validated - The signatures were verified against the specified public key What's Changed fix(completion): accept a tool_choice that forces an OpenAI hosted tool by @kerry-berri in #50578 fix(accounting): stop delivery metrics from scanning retained receipts on every flush by @joshua-berri in #50565 fix(key/info): return 400 instead of 500 when no key is provided by @apex-mochen in #43577 fix(gemini): add the Flex above-200k cache read price to gemini-3.1-pro-preview rows by @devin-ai-integration [bot] in #50607 test(observability): match the full card number instead of a 4111 substri
